title: Reduce repair WebView flat exports
summary: Removed nine Completed/Pending repair and reconcile flat WebView aliases while preserving namespace access and child-module hooks.
reason: The open WebView flat-export cleanup workstream calls for opportunistic namespace-first reductions by touched domain. The repair controls were already exposed through the Completed and Pending Publish namespace objects and did not need parent flat compatibility aliases.
behavior_before: Completed and Pending Publish repair controls were available both through their namespace objects and through nine direct parent `window.*` aliases. Browser smoke readiness checks still required those flat globals.
behavior_after: Completed and Pending Publish repair controls remain available through `window.mediaPipelineCompletedView` and `window.mediaPipelinePendingPublishView`, while the nine direct parent flat aliases are removed. Page-owned browser smokes now verify the namespace members directly, and the WebView export inventory/public-contract baseline reflect the lower flat-export count.
manual_validation: refresh_summaries --check for changed WebView files - passed
targeted WebView global export inventory tests - passed
rollback_plan: Revert this packet, restore the nine parent flat alias assignments in completedView.js and pendingPublishView.js, restore the browser smoke flat-global readiness checks, and regenerate the WebView inventory/public-contract/summaries.
notes:
Remove repair/reconcile parent flat aliases and move page-owned smoke readiness checks to namespace members.
Refresh WebView public contract and global export inventory after removing repair flat aliases.
Refresh generated summaries for WebView asset, smoke, and inventory/public-contract files.
webview:prework:check was also attempted; it stopped at the existing lint-budget drift gate after webview:check passed, so the lint budget was not updated in this scoped export cleanup.
